user.title: Connect Deglaze
user.description: Enter the email address used for Deglaze. In the next step, paste a fresh sign-in link from your Deglaze email. Do not open/click the link before pasting it here, because the one-time code may be consumed.

link.title: Complete email-link sign-in
link.description: Request a sign-in email through the Deglaze website, copy the full link from the email, and paste it below. The link contains a one-time credential; it is sent directly from Home Assistant to Firebase and is not stored in the config entry or written to logs.

data.sign_in_link: Full sign-in link from the Deglaze email

error.invalid_link: This is not a recognized Deglaze Firebase sign-in link. Request a fresh link and paste it without opening it.
error.invalid_auth: The link is expired or already used. Request a new Deglaze sign-in email and try again.
error.auth_failed: Firebase rejected the sign-in link. Verify the account email and try a fresh link.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not complete sign-in or retrieve the Deglaze grocery list. Check connectivity and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Deglaze account is already configured.

test_auth_renewal.name: Test authentication renewal
test_auth_renewal.description: Simulate access-token expiry in memory, refresh through Firebase, then verify a read-only Deglaze request. No grocery items are changed.

test_error_handling.name: Test error handling and recovery
test_error_handling.description: Simulate one local HTTP 503 response through the normal API error path, then verify a real read-only grocery-list request recovers. The simulated failure is not sent to Deglaze and no grocery items are changed.

set_recipe_collections.name: Set recipe collections
set_recipe_collections.description: Assign a recipe to or remove it from existing visible Deglaze collections. Collection definitions are not created or deleted.

update_meal_plan_item.name: Update planned meal
update_meal_plan_item.description: Update a planned meal date, meal slot, or leftovers flag using the current item version.

remove_meal_plan_item.name: Remove planned meal
remove_meal_plan_item.description: Remove a planned meal from Deglaze. The Lovelace weekly planner confirms before removal.

rename_grocery_store.name: Rename grocery store
rename_grocery_store.description: Rename an existing Deglaze store using its latest version.

delete_grocery_store.name: Delete grocery store
delete_grocery_store.description: Delete a store definition. Items remain on the grocery list but lose this store association.

set_grocery_item_stores.name: Set grocery item stores
set_grocery_item_stores.description: Replace the store assignments for an existing grocery item. Use an empty store list to remove all assignments.
